label: Bible Study
prompt: But seek ye first the _____ of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
verse: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
note: 'Seek ye first' — the ordering of priorities that makes everything else 'added.'

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you _____, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
verse: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
note: The KJV drops the 's' — 'alway' — but the promise loses nothing: with you, all the way.

label: Sunday School
prompt: I will praise thee; for I am _____ and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
verse: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
note: 'Fearfully and wonderfully made' — fearfully here means awe, not anxiety.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But his word was in mine heart as a burning _____ shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not stay.
verse: Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not stay.
note: Jeremiah tried to quit prophesying once — the word burned in his bones until he gave up giving up.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Be not deceived: evil _____ corrupt good manners.
verse: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
note: 'Evil communications corrupt good manners' — the KJV's rendering of 'bad company.'
